description: This is a PHP source file defining the VacancyRestController class, which handles REST API requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) related to Vacancy resources in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It provides an endpoint to retrieve vacancy details by ID and stubs for other CRUD operations.

classes.name: VacancyRestController
classes.description: Controller class for handling REST API requests related to Vacancy entities in the recruitment system, supporting get operations and placeholders for create, update, delete.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve vacancy details by ID. Throws RecordNotFoundException if vacancy is not found or inactive.
